Widening the well by q replaces L by L + q, giving wavelengths 712.1032, 1848.3914 and 2393.4581 nm for q = 1.3, 2.4 and 2.8 nm respectively.

The photon carries the level-energy difference, with negligible wall recoil.
For the current widening sentences, 0.5 nm is the width before widening.
The explicitly stated present width determines the spectrum independently of an earlier experiment.
